about:
# Player Snake
This mod adds a <cy>snake</c> made of <cg>player icons</c> that follows you through the level.

<cr>Warning:</c> a <co>large number of icons</c> may cause <cr>lag</c>.

# Support
Check the <cy>support</c> info (<cg>green</c> gift button =3).
changelog:
# 1.1.0
Changes:
- <cg>Added</c> a quick settings button to the pause menu
- <cg>Added</c> the <cy>Enabled</c> setting
- <cg>Added</c> the <cy>Stop snake on death</c> setting
- Icons closer to the player are now drawn above the farther ones
- The snake is now <cy>rebuilt on level restart</c> when settings change, so re-entering the level is no longer needed

# 1.0.0
- <cg>Released</c> the mod!
